title: Move windows based on "Relative position" disables expand to multiple zones + minimize/maximize window hotkeys
author: anderspk
summary: FancyZones Relative position mode consumes directional window-management shortcuts but does not provide Zone index mode's multi-zone expansion or preserve all native minimize/maximize behavior.
next_action: Reclassify as a FancyZones keyboard-navigation enhancement and define shortcut precedence and mode-independent commands.

confidence.rationale: The requested outcome is explicitly framed as combining or adding controls across modes.

judgment.rationale: The report asks to combine capabilities from two navigation modes and requests alternative hotkeys; it describes a product interaction gap rather than evidence that one mode violates its documented algorithm.
evidence: The behavior changes when switching between Relative position and Zone index.
The requested multi-zone expansion is specifically tied to the Win+Ctrl+Alt+Arrow shortcut.
The reporter asks for an alternative customizable hotkey if native minimize/maximize cannot coexist.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify as a FancyZones keyboard-navigation enhancement and define shortcut precedence and mode-independent commands.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue requests new shortcut and cross-mode behavior rather than identifying a confirmed defect in one implementation path.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones Relative position mode consumes directional window-management shortcuts but does not provide Zone index mode's multi-zone expansion or preserve all native minimize/maximize behavior.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.74.1.
Relative position is preferred for one-row grid movement.
The request covers both native window commands and FancyZones multi-zone expansion.
inferences: Relative navigation and zone-index expansion likely have different adjacency/state requirements, while Windows shortcut interception creates a separate precedence decision.
issue_context.analysis: A product-level command model is needed before code work; treating this as one regression would hide the requested new cross-mode behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report and live labels.
Confirmed there is no maintainer response, linked fix, or current reproduction evidence.

actions.label: Reclassify as FancyZones shortcut enhancement

comment.body: This request combines capabilities that currently belong to different FancyZones movement modes: Relative position navigation, Zone index multi-zone expansion, and native minimize/maximize shortcuts. Please track it as a keyboard-navigation enhancement and define which commands must be mode-independent, their default/customizable shortcuts, and precedence versus Windows shell shortcuts before implementation.
